Confluence has no footnote of its ownfootnote-ref-1[1], so mark builds one out of the anchor macrofootnote-ref-2[2].

A note may be cited more than oncefootnote-ref-1-1[1], and each citation gets its own way back.

A note may carry markupfootnote-ref-3[3] of its own.
